title: God Shall Scatter His Enemies

questions.question: God shall arise, his enemies shall be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 68:1 (ESV): "God shall arise, his enemies shall be scattered;"

questions.question: As smoke is driven away, so you shall drive whom away?
questions.explanation: Psalm 68:2 (ESV): "As smoke is driven away, so you shall drive them away;"

questions.question: As wax melts before fire, so the wicked shall perish before whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 68:2 (ESV): "...so the wicked shall perish before God!"

questions.question: But the righteous shall be glad; they shall exult before God; they shall be jubilant with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 68:3 (ESV): "...they shall be jubilant with joy!"

questions.question: Sing to God, sing praises to his name; lift up a song to him who rides through the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 68:4 (ESV): "...lift up a song to him who rides through the deserts;"

questions.question: Father of the fatherless and protector of widows is God in his holy what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 68:5 (ESV): "Father of the fatherless and protector of widows is God in his holy habitation."

questions.question: O God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness, the earth did what?
The Lord gives the word; the women who announce the news are a great what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 68:11 (ESV): "...the women who announce the news are a great host:"

questions.question: The kings of the armies—they flee, they flee! The women at home divide the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 68:12 (ESV): "...The women at home divide the spoil—"

questions.question: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears us up; God is our what?
God shall shatter the head of his enemies, the hairy crown of him who walks in his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 68:21 (ESV): "...the hairy crown of him who walks in his guilty ways."

questions.question: That you may strike your feet in their blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 68:23 (ESV): "...that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from the foe."

questions.question: Your procession is seen, O God, the procession of my God, my King, into the what?
Summon your power, O God, the power, O God, by which you have worked for whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 68:28 (ESV): "...the power, O God, by which you have worked for us."

questions.question: O kingdoms of the earth, sing to God; sing praises to the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 68:32 (ESV): "O kingdoms of the earth, sing to God; sing praises to the Lord,"

key_verse_text: God shall arise, his enemies shall be scattered; and those who hate him shall flee before him!
